scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @miniledger/api
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @miniledger/api
scripts.dev:mobile: npm run build:shared && npm run start -w @miniledger/mobile
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm run web -w @miniledger/mobile
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:shared && vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.ts
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build:shared && npm run migrate -w @miniledger/api
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
